text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa had sustained an injury, so 
I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Said I should take a break for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no way I could give 
permission to run on a gamble like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...That said, don't you think banning 
every single thing is going a bit too far?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There may be limits, but there's still 
plenty we can do. You catch my drift, 
right?
choice_data_list:
Because you never know what might 
happen...
Shall we look for things we can do?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Listen, this ain't a bet. It's not even a 
matter of winning or losing in the first 
place.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me I'm not even allowed to 
prep the groundwork to pull up to the 
racing table?
choice_data_list:
If you mess up the prep, you won't even be 
able to compete, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, you always have a comeback for 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you ain't budgin' no matter 
what I say. Fine, I get it. I just gotta 
sit still, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she still looked unconvinced, I 
managed to get Nakayama Festa to get some 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah, well then, back to the course—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, just walking sends jolts right 
through it. Finding something I can do is 
the least of my worries now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, training was called off, and 
she was forced to take it easy and rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright... as long as I don't push down 
too hard, it doesn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, what do you wanna try first? Just 
say the word, don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us exercised within 
limits while keeping an eye on the injury.
